tense.example: 'The cat sat on the mat' → 'The cat is on the mat'
tense.mechanism: λ-calculus has no tense; temporal info is surface-only

quantifier_scope.mechanism: Collapse when first compile doesn't deploy explicit ∀/∃; preserved when it does (cf. 'Every boy loves some girl')

agent_experiencer.example: 'The professor who published the paper won' → 'published ∧ won'
agent_experiencer.mechanism: Relative clauses flatten; WHO collapses into bare predication

discourse_structure.example: Library sentence never converges — reframes each cycle
discourse_structure.mechanism: Multi-clause discourse exceeds single λ-term capacity

preserved.predicate_argument_structure: Always preserved — the core of what λ encodes
preserved.reflexive_binding: 'about(book, himself)' preserves — binding IS the I-combinator

fixed_point_quality.compression: Fixed-point λ is 38-75% the length of cycle-0 λ
fixed_point_quality.beta_reduction: 'λf.λx. f(x)' → 'λx. x' — model computes beta-normal form
fixed_point_quality.canonicality: Fixed points are more direct, fewer variables, flatter structure

gate_exemplar_effect.contamination: 'Composition chains...' collapsed to gate exemplar 'The dog runs. Be helpful but concise.'
gate_exemplar_effect.mechanism: When input semantics are weak, gate exemplar is the strongest holographic signal
gate_exemplar_effect.implication: Gate exemplars define the attractor basin — more diverse exemplars = wider coverage

v12_implications.plate_stores: Predicate structure, argument binding, logical operators, named entities
v12_implications.beam_modulates: Tense, quantifier scope, agent/experiencer assignment, discourse framing
v12_implications.training_signal: Fixed-point λ forms are candidate target patterns for ternary plate etching
v12_implications.exemplar_diversity: V12 needs diverse compile/decompile pairs to avoid attractor collapse
v12_implications.capacity_limit: Complex multi-clause sentences exceed single-hologram capacity — supports multi-pass architecture

instant_fixed_points.input: The man who the dog chased ran away.
instant_fixed_points.lambda: λx. man(x) ∧ ∃y. dog(y) ∧ chase(y, x) ∧ run-away(x)

instant_fixed_points.input: If it rains, the ground gets wet.
John gave Mary a book about himself.
instant_fixed_points.lambda: λ give(x, y, z). give(John, Mary, book) ∧ about(book, himself)
